source.name: God of Prompt
source.subject: You don't have a Claude problem. You have a blank-chat problem.

raw_signal: AI users are not only blocked by model quality. They are blocked by blank-chat friction: not knowing what to ask, how to structure the task, or how to reuse workflows.
buyer: Claude users, ChatGPT users, AI beginners, creators, solo operators, and business owners trying to use AI repeatedly.
pain: They open AI tools but do not know what to type. They rewrite prompts from scratch and fail to create repeatable workflows.
why_now: AI skills, reusable prompt packs, and workflow templates are becoming a more understandable product format than abstract prompt engineering.
first_product: A pack of reusable AI skills for business builders: idea validation, offer creation, landing page drafting, DM writing, content generation, and build prompt creation.
price: Free starter pack, then $19-$29 for the complete pack.
distribution: Gumroad, X, beehiiv, Reddit AI communities, Claude communities, AI beginner audiences.
lead_magnet_angle: 10 AI skills that remove the blank-chat problem.
content_angle: You do not have an AI problem. You have a blank-product problem.
bilion_access_angle: Bilion turns vague AI business ideas into reusable build, content, and monetization workflows.
